_comment: THE CLOSED-FORM UNTAP LOOP (AccomplishedAlchemist chunk C2b): Crab Umbra on Accomplished Alchemist,
Nourish for 6, loop the Umbra until the float pays Stroke of Genius for the opponent's whole library.
Turn 4: 3 Forests + an Island + a non-sick Alchemist wearing a Crab Umbra ({2}{U}: untap enchanted
creature). Hand: Nourish ({G}{G}: gain 6) and Stroke of Genius. Opponent library 40, so the kill is
Stroke at the opponent for X = 40 = {40}{2}{U} = 43 mana. Without the loop the turn tops out at
1 Forest + Island + the Alchemist's 6 = 8 mana. With it: Nourish -> (lifegain re-plan) -> the Umbra
loop (ActivateUntap, chosen_x = kUntapLoopToNeed) nets 6 - 3 = 3 blue per iteration until the float
covers 43 -> (kActUntapLoopFunded re-plan) -> Stroke X = 40 at the opponent decks them THIS turn.
